[[Lake Verity]] }} '''Tackling Tangrowth''' (Japanese: '''VS モジャンボ''' ''VS Tangrowth''), titled '''VS Tangrowth''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 398th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 61st chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''The Three Pokémon and Their Invisible Bond''' (Japanese: '''三匹と見えないつながり''' ''The Three and Invisible Bonds'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''The Three and Invisible Bonds''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Pearl}} feels the full force of an explosion. [[Rad Rickshaw]]'s two {{p|Clefairy}}, Cliff and Cliffette, struggle to hold onto their {{pkmn|Trainer}}. Pearl survives, but sees around him that everything has been dried up, leaving [[Lake Valor]] as nothing but a pit of {{p|Magikarp}} flopping about. The operator of the UFO-like vessel that also survived the explosion and continues to hold Pearl hostage, now laughs maniacally. [[Saturn]] beams with pride that his boss chose his lake to be the Galactic Bomb's target. Saturn shakes off Pearl's team of three {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} and continues to interrogate the boy for an answer to his question. Pearl, with nothing to hide, gives his explanation - one which Saturn greets with laughter. He claims that Pearl saw none other than {{p|Azelf}}. With that, he brings Pearl into the central island's cavern and orders his Grunts in as well, to prepare their 'Formation A'. As Azelf begins to materialize inside Valor Cavern, so too do {{p|Uxie}} and {{p|Mesprit}} from their respective lake caverns. Within moments, the latter two shoot out of their caverns, causing {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Platinum}} to feel a sense of nostalgia at their appearances. [[Candice]] wonders why Uxie came around even though the bomb did not blow up [[Lake Acuity]], and [[Jupiter]] states that it is because of the bond the three [[Lake guardians]] share. With that, Jupiter's {{p|Tangrowth}} shoots out its vines towards Uxie. Candice tries to respond by commanding her {{TP|Candice|Froslass}}, but she and Froslass are impaled by a {{m|Stone Edge}} from Jupiter's {{p|Gastrodon}} before they can react. Maylene then tries to keep Jupiter's {{p|Sableye}} at bay with her {{p|Meditite}}. Alas, Sableye strikes both Maylene and her Meditite down, justifying Jupiter's claim that she is 'too weak'. By this time, the aircraft above Lake Acuity has fully deployed its capture device, which charges at Uxie. Jupiter smirks that with both her companions down, Platinum's resistance is nothing but futile. Jupiter brings out her evidence by throwing a [[Passho Berry]] towards her Tangrowth, just as Platinum orders her {{TP|Platinum|Rapidash}} to burn the capture device. Tangrowth catches the berry and turns it into a flood of water that knocks Rapidash out before it gets near the capture device, which has captured Uxie. It retracts into the aircraft which leaves the area as Platinum looks on with despair. ==Major events== * The Galactic Bomb's target is revealed to be [[Lake Valor]]. * The {{adv|Lake guardians}} rise from their lakes in response to Lake Valor being blown up. * {{p|Uxie}} is captured. * {{adv|Platinum}}, [[Maylene]], and [[Candice]] are defeated by [[Jupiter]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Azelf}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Maylene]] * [[Candice]] * [[Mars]] * [[Jupiter]] * [[Saturn]] * [[Rad Rickshaw]] * {{adv|Sebastian}} * [[Dr. Footstep]] (flashback) * {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Chatot}} ([[Chatler]]/{{tt|Chahiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Infernape}} ([[Chimler]]/{{tt|Chimhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Luxray}} ([[Rayler]]/{{tt|Rayhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Rapidash}} ({{OP|Platinum|Rapidash}}) * {{p|Riolu}} ([[Maylene]]'s) * {{p|Meditite}} ([[Maylene]]'s) * {{p|Abomasnow}} ([[Candice]]'s) * {{p|Froslass}} ({{OP|Candice|Froslass}}) * {{p|Yanmega}} ([[Mars]]'s) * {{p|Sableye}} ([[Jupiter]]'s) * {{p|Gastrodon}} ([[Jupiter]]'s; {{form|Gastrodon|West Sea}}) * {{p|Tangrowth}} ([[Jupiter]]'s) * {{p|Clefairy}} (Cliff and Cliffette/{{tt|Pippirin and Pippiran|Chuang Yi}}; [[Rad Rickshaw]]'s) * {{p|Rapidash}} ({{adv|Sebastian}}'s) * {{p|Haunter}} ({{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s'; multiple) * {{p|Machamp}} ({{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s'; multiple) * {{p|Uxie}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Uxie|Adventures}}) * {{p|Mesprit}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Mesprit|Adventures}}) * {{p|Azelf}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Azelf|Adventures}}; debut) * {{p|Magikarp}} (multiple) * {{p|Staraptor}} (flashback) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 巨蔓藤|VS Tangrowth}} |fr=Trois Pokémon et leurs liens invisibles |de=VS.
